<h2>Validate Current Calibration Preparation Dependencies</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Blocks stale preparation without executing analytical pipeline targets.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_sjsdm_cv_preparation_freshness(
  pipeline_script,
  store_path,
  target_names,
  manifest_function = targets::tar_manifest,
  network_function = targets::tar_network,
  outdated_function = targets::tar_outdated,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw,
  verify_folds_function = is_sjsdm_cv_prepared_folds_current,
  verify_mapping_function = is_sjsdm_cv_preparation_mapping_current,
  load_metadata_function = targets::tar_meta
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="pipeline_script">pipeline_script</code>, <code id="store_path">store_path</code></td>
<td>
<p>Current pipeline definition and its existing unit store.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_names">target_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Prepared input endpoints whose upstream dependencies must be current.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="manifest_function">manifest_function</code>, <code id="network_function">network_function</code>, <code id="outdated_function">outdated_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable public targets inspection functions.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable cached target reader for configuration comparisons.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="verify_folds_function">verify_folds_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable exact in-memory proof for preparation-only code differences.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="verify_mapping_function">verify_mapping_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable exact in-memory proof for the known pure community mapper.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="load_metadata_function">load_metadata_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable public cached-target metadata reader. Missing dependency records
block validation before shortcut inspection; analytical work is not run.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Always-cued configuration commands are read-only and compared exactly with
cached values. Other always-cued ancestors are rejected. All remaining
ancestors are checked individually with shortcut inspection, avoiding the
false propagation of unchanged always-cued configuration into their users.
The two known shared-memory interpolation handles are operational wrappers;
their durable input ancestors are inspected instead of creating new handles.
Required cached dependency records are checked before shortcut inspection,
which cannot bootstrap newly introduced targets without metadata.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Invisibly, 'NULL' after successful validation.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
validate_sjsdm_cv_preparation_freshness(
  "R/Pipelines/pipeline.R", "Data/targets/store", "prepared_folds"
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>
